issues.message: The Root Data Entity SHOULD have a `publisher` property (Organization or Person)

check.label: RECOMMENDED 56.1
check.name: Root Data Entity: RECOMMENDED `publisher` property
check.description:
Check if the Root Data Entity has a `publisher` property.
            The RO-Crate specification recommends that the Root Data Entity includes
            a publisher (Organization or Person) to describe who is responsible for
            making the RO-Crate available.

requirement.name: Root Data Entity: recommended publisher
requirement.description:
The Root Data Entity SHOULD have a `publisher` property
        referencing an Organization or Person (as per schema.org).
